one_liner: Cloud accounting software providing a REST API for managing invoices, customers, vendors, and financial data.
access_notes: A free developer account allows immediate sandbox access, but production access requires an app assessment and approval process.
verdict_reason: Self-serve sandbox access is available, but moving to production requires going through Intuit's app assessment process.

evidence.snippet: The QuickBooks Online API uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code flow exclusively. There are no API keys or basic auth options.
A QuickBooks developer account is free. You can sign up at the Intuit Developer Portal and get immediate sandbox access.
Production: For real data, requires app assessment (yes, really)
Yes. QuickBooks Online provides a REST-based Accounting API that developers can use to read and write accounting data
QuickBooks Online webhook notifications have moved to the CloudEvents format.
QuickBooks Sandbox: Testing integrations with sample company data
Intuit publishes an open-source QuickBooks Online MCP server on GitHub
